crusadecraft.news.dispute: %1$s founds %2$s at the gates of %3$s: the two realms dispute these lands.
crusadecraft.codex.civ.p2: A realm that has had a built camp for a few days $(l)founds a village$() nearby: a hamlet of four houses and a well, one more city on the map, and two families in the register (they appear with Comes Alive). The village then grows by $(l)quarters$() of two houses: town, then city.$(br2)Founding near another realm's lands causes a $(l)dispute$(): opinion drops on both sides. $(l)/crusade civ annuler$() also undoes cities, quarters and inhabitants.
